lessons_used: Reordering sign-in earlier and adding targeted sign-in hints or copy improved conversion, whereas placing sign-in after the adoption certificate severely hurt conversion.
Adding focused individual screens (Interactive Welcome, Sound Calibration, Pet Personality Intro, Visibility Check) won, while multi-step setup flows consistently degraded conversion.

Select layout redesigns (Pick Friend stage/carousel, Story scroll/stage/carousel, Choose Path grid, Checklist intro) won, but photo upload redesigns and waiting screen spotlight redesigns severely hurt conversion.
Desktop activity and interaction hints won, whereas standalone headline updates, audio cues, progress bars, and tip carousels mostly showed no clear effect.
Predictions were overly pessimistic for major winning features, forecasting negative or small gains (such as -0.2% or -7.8%) for changes that delivered up to +14.0% improvements.
Predictions were overly optimistic for non-winning or failing changes, forecasting gains up to +12.0% on interventions that showed no clear effect or caused severe drops.

candidates.title: Story Screen Checklist Layout Redesign
candidates.change: Redesign the story screen into a checklist layout summarizing what to expect during pet setup.
candidates.why: Story screen layout redesigns have consistently proven effective at boosting user engagement early in choose_path.

guard.reason: The story screen's job is to introduce the pet, which is lost when converted to a setup checklist.

candidates.title: Sign-In Account Reconnect Safety Hint
candidates.change: Display a hint on sign-in clarifying that logging into an existing account safely recovers previously created pets and settings.
candidates.why: Support received 8 emails regarding missing or reset pets when users accidentally log in under a new account.

sign_in.hint: Logging into your existing account instantly restores your saved pets and progress.

guard.reason: Adding a sign-in account recovery hint is valid and follows all base rules.

candidates.score_note: Sign-in hints have strong historical backing (+2.1% avg) and direct support email evidence.

candidates.title: Reorder Sign-In After Pick Friend Screen
candidates.change: Move the sign-in step to immediately after selecting a companion on the pick_friend screen.
candidates.why: Placing sign-in right after pet selection captures user commitment while keeping account preservation early in the funnel.

guard.reason: Reordering sign-in after pick_friend is explicitly allowed within onboarding.

candidates.score_note: Moving sign-in earlier fits general lessons, but sign-in reordering tests averaged -4.5% historically.

candidates.title: New Companion Name Confirmation Screen
candidates.change: Add a dedicated pet naming screen right after pick_friend where users enter and confirm their pet's name.
candidates.why: Adoption step has high drop-off (86.4%) and long duration (89s); giving users a quick dedicated naming moment increases personal connection.

new_pet_name_confirmation_screen.headline: Name Your New Pet Companion
new_pet_name_confirmation_screen.body: Give your desktop friend a unique name before generating their profile.

guard.reason: Adding a pet naming confirmation screen during onboarding is permitted.

candidates.score_note: Adoption has high drop-off (13.6%); focused individual screens have strong history (+6.3% avg).

candidates.title: Pick Friend Screen Two Column Layout Redesign
candidates.change: Redesign the Pick Friend companion selection screen to use a side-by-side two-column layout.
candidates.why: Adoption step takes a median of 89s and mean of 1017s, indicating users need a clearer side-by-side view to compare pets faster.

guard.reason: Redesigning pick_friend to a two-column layout preserves its core job.

candidates.score_note: Long adoption time supports intervention, but adoption redesigns consistently hurt conversion (-5.6% avg).

candidates.title: Adoption Certificate Companion Guarantee Hint
candidates.change: Add a reassurance hint to the adoption certificate screen confirming desktop pet settings are saved.
candidates.why: Adoption step completion drops to 86.4%; reinforcing companion setup completion reduces drop-offs.

adoption_certificate.hint: Your desktop companion setup is complete and securely registered.

guard.reason: Adding a setup reassurance hint to the adoption certificate screen is compliant.

candidates.score_note: Low-cost reassurance hint at high drop-off step, though general copy/hints have modest impact.

candidates.title: New Companion Mood Preview Screen
candidates.change: Add a short companion mood selection screen after adoption certificate to preview how the pet reacts on desktop.
candidates.why: Pre-building post-adoption companion familiarity addresses user confusion about how pets behave and interact.

new_companion_mood_preview.headline: Choose Your Pet's Initial Mood
new_companion_mood_preview.body: Select how your pet greets you when appearing on your desktop.

guard.reason: Inserting a companion mood preview screen in onboarding is allowed.

candidates.score_note: Multi-step setup flows consistently degrade conversion despite intent to set post-adoption expectations.

candidates.title: Waiting Screen System Tray Loading Hint
candidates.change: Display a background hint on the waiting screen explaining that the pet launches into the system tray when ready.
candidates.why: Support reported users lost track of pets on startup or thought the app failed to open after generation.

waiting.hint: Your pet is initializing and will appear in your system tray upon completion.

guard.reason: Adding an informative system tray hint on the waiting screen is compliant.

candidates.score_note: Directly backed by support tickets and desktop interaction hint lessons, with positive historical data.

candidates.title: Home Intro Companion Tray Icon Prompt
candidates.change: Enable background system notification on the home intro screen directing users to the taskbar tray icon.
candidates.why: Multiple support emails showed confusion regarding how to find, show, or control the pet on the desktop after setup.

home_intro.hint: Look for your pet's companion icon in the system tray to control visibility anytime.

guard.reason: Adding system tray notifications to home_intro is permitted inside onboarding.

candidates.score_note: Finish step has highest drop (20%) and multiple emails, but notifications on finish average -0.3%.

candidates.title: Home Intro Screen Centered Layout Redesign
candidates.change: Redesign the home intro screen layout to a centered focus presentation with primary action buttons.
candidates.why: Finish step drops to 80.0% conversion; a clean centered layout reduces visual clutter on final setup.

guard.reason: Redesigning the home_intro screen to a centered layout is allowed.

candidates.score_note: Finish step offers huge recovery potential; finish redesigns show modest positive historical gains (+1.4%).
